_help: Executable-R (E-R) column of the camera-ready Table 3 (dataset v1.0.1, re-issued). Deprecate E-R is computed only over the text-supported gold Deprecate triples whose (s,p,o) is in the KG snapshot T_t of the instance's year: a deprecation can only be executed as an edit on G_t. The other supported Deprecates (an entity minted after t, or a statement entered into Wikidata only after t) stay in the dataset and are scored by Completeness and G-BERTScore-R; E-R cannot evaluate them by definition. Exists / Add E-R are unchanged. Inputs = the two s04 results files (run s04_evaluate_predictions with the configs 20261023_v1_0_1_reissue and 20261028_kg_aware_v1_0_1_reissue first), the test set and the KG snapshots (./scripts/download_data.sh --kg). Script: scripts/stats/executable_recall_deprecate_in_snapshot.py.
_expected_help: expected_s04_er = E-R as the s04 cie_exact_match metric reports it (all supported gold); the script stops unless its re-score reproduces these. expected_table3_er = the camera-ready Table 3 E-R column; the script stops unless the restricted values match (tolerance 0.05). expected_counts = supported test Deprecates and their split.
